name: Clear Lake
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A North Coast AVA in Lake County, centered on Clear Lake, the largest natural lake entirely within California. Sub-areas include Big Valley District-Lake County, Kelsey Bench-Lake County and Red Hills Lake County, and most of High Valley lies inside it.
